The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4205f51d8f1b130b), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 16-17. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. statement: The thresholds and the domain above can be chosen with the following properties. The numbers cb, cw < 0 are right-continuity points of their respective full maximal-region families. The boundary of Ω consists of the faces in Equation (3.8), has disjoint 16 smooth outward leaf collars as in Lemma 3.3, and preserves the enclosing-area lower bound in Equation (3.9). There are a smooth compactly supported function C on Ω, constants Cb ≥ 0, Cw ≤ 0, and positive constants kB on its face collars such that Cw ≤ C ≤ Cb, C = Cb − kBs in a black collar near Bb, C = Cw + kBs in a white collar near Bw. (3.23) For an absent type, its corresponding constant is simply a bound. Set b− = cb − Cb < 0, b+ = −cw − Cw > 0. (3.24) There is a smooth positive function ρ, equal to a positive constant times r−4 on the far end and satisfying symbol derivative bounds there, such that, for every h ∈ [b−, b+], |(h + C) tr K| + |∇C| + ρ ≤ 1 2m everywhere on Ω. (3.25) The thresholds, collars, offset, and ρ are fixed before the deformation parameters are chosen. After fixing the thresholds and collars, the offset and its first derivatives can be made arbitrarily small.
